basics.description:
## Omzig M365 Zero Trust Deployment

Deploy a secure Microsoft 365 environment with **NSA-aligned Zero Trust** controls and optional **HIPAA compliance**.

### What this deploys:
- Conditional Access policies with MFA
- Defender for Office 365 protection
- Defender for Endpoint configuration
- Data Loss Prevention policies
- Sensitivity labels and encryption
- Security monitoring and alerting

basics.name: orgName
basics.label: Organization Name
basics.toolTip: Short name for your organization (2-24 characters, lowercase letters and numbers only). Used for resource naming.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be 2-24 lowercase letters and numbers only.

elements.name: orgSize
elements.label: Organization Size
elements.toolTip: Select your organization size to optimize default settings.

constraints.validationMessage: Please enter a valid domain name.

elements.name: adminEmail
elements.label: Admin Notification Email
elements.toolTip: Email address for security alerts and notifications.

constraints.validationMessage: Please enter a valid email address.

options.text: Select the Microsoft 365 and Defender licenses available in your tenant. This determines which security features can be configured.

elements.name: m365License
elements.label: Microsoft 365 License Tier
elements.toolTip: Select your primary Microsoft 365 license tier.

elements.name: defenderForOfficePlan
elements.label: Defender for Office 365
elements.toolTip: Select your Defender for Office 365 plan. Plan 2 is recommended for full protection.

elements.name: hasDefenderForEndpoint
elements.label: Defender for Endpoint available
elements.toolTip: Check if you have Defender for Endpoint licenses (included in M365 E5 or as add-on).

elements.name: hasEntraIdP2
elements.label: Entra ID P2 available
elements.toolTip: Check if you have Entra ID P2 licenses for advanced Conditional Access and Identity Protection.

options.text: Select your security baseline level. Higher levels provide stronger protection but may require more user adjustment.

elements.name: securityLevel
elements.label: Security Baseline Level
elements.toolTip: Choose the security baseline that matches your organization's risk tolerance.

options.text: **Standard**: Basic Zero Trust controls. MFA required, legacy auth blocked, basic DLP.
**Enhanced**: Recommended for most organizations. Compliant device requirements, risk-based Conditional Access, advanced threat protection.
**Maximum**: Strictest controls for high-security environments. All protections in Block mode, phishing threshold at maximum, restricted data sharing.

elements.name: requireMfa
elements.label: Require MFA for all users
elements.toolTip: Strongly recommended. Require multi-factor authentication for all user sign-ins.

elements.name: blockLegacyAuth
elements.label: Block legacy authentication
elements.toolTip: Block older authentication protocols that don't support MFA.

elements.name: requireCompliantDevice
elements.label: Require compliant device
elements.toolTip: Require devices to meet compliance policies before accessing resources.

options.text: HIPAA mode enables stricter controls for healthcare organizations handling Protected Health Information (PHI). This includes: 7-year log retention, PHI sensitivity labels, stricter DLP policies, and reduced session timeouts.

elements.name: hipaaEnabled
elements.label: Enable HIPAA-aligned configuration
elements.toolTip: Enable additional controls aligned with HIPAA requirements. Note: This is a configuration tool, not a certification.

elements.name: enableDlp
elements.label: Enable Data Loss Prevention
elements.toolTip: Enable DLP policies to prevent accidental sharing of sensitive information.

elements.name: enableSensitivityLabels
elements.label: Enable Sensitivity Labels
elements.toolTip: Enable sensitivity labels for classifying and protecting documents.

elements.name: retentionDays
elements.label: Default Retention Period (days)
elements.toolTip: Default retention period for emails and documents. HIPAA requires minimum 7 years (2555 days).

options.text: Review your configuration before deployment. The deployment will create Azure resources and configure Microsoft 365 security settings.

[concat('**Organization:** ', basics('orgName'), '

**Environment:** ', basics('environmentName'), '

**Security Baseline:** ', steps('securityBaseline').securityLevel, '

**HIPAA Mode:** ', if(steps('compliance').hipaaSection.hipaaEnabled, 'Enabled', 'Disabled'), '

**Defender for Office 365:** ', steps('licensing').defenderForOfficePlan)]
Conditional Access policies will be deployed in Report-Only mode initially. Review and enable them in the Entra admin center after deployment.
